testCases.title: Valid Keyword Search
preconditions: User is on the product search page.
steps: Enter a valid search keyword in the search input field.
expectedResults: Matching products related to the entered keyword are displayed.

testCases.title: Invalid Keyword Search
preconditions: User is on the product search page.
steps: Enter a search keyword that does not match any products.
expectedResults: An empty result message is presented to the user.
